rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9378:details:0: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of ⟦E13⟧. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.
rows.quest:9664:obj:0: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the ⟦E5⟧, then return to ⟦E46⟧ at ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:9664:details:0: Welcome to the ⟦E47⟧, ⟦199⟧. As you know, the ⟦E48⟧ and their allies hold the lands to the west of here against our best efforts. The ⟦E50⟧ commanders have decided that here in the east, we will establish new fortifications to tighten the noose around our enemies.
rows.quest:9664:details:1: Towers long abandoned since the days of Lordaeron are to be seized and rebuilt for this purpose. These lands are dangerous, and we could use your help.
rows.quest:9664:progress:0: When the towers are under our control, we will soon be able to surround the ⟦E48⟧. After that, it is only a matter of time before we can crush them.
rows.quest:9664:completion:0: Very good, ⟦200⟧. It will be important for us to hold these towers against future attacks, and for that we may need your assistance until reinforcements can be brought in to secure the area.
rows.quest:9665:obj:0: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the ⟦E5⟧, then return to ⟦E52⟧ at ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:9665:details:0: Agents of the ⟦E48⟧ uncovered an ⟦E50⟧ plot to establish new bases here in the ⟦E5⟧, at abandoned towers throughout the area.
rows.quest:9665:details:1: It is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this ⟦E50⟧ incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
rows.quest:9665:progress:0: They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.⟦201⟧⟦202⟧We will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.
rows.quest:9665:completion:0: This is good news, ⟦203⟧. It will be a constant struggle here in the ⟦E47⟧ until we have fully driven back the forces of the ⟦E50⟧.
rows.quest:9665:completion:1: Until that day, I hope that we will have your continued assistance.
